reader.requirement: At --std 85, a file control entry with no ORGANIZATION clause is a sequential file, with every sequential behaviour (WRITE without INVALID KEY, EXTEND, REWRITE in place, record order).
reader.edition-search: FileModel.Organization defaults to FileOrganization.Sequential and OrganizationWritten false; grep DialectLevel|EditionContext|DialectBehavior around Organization in FileControlBinder.cs and FileModel.cs found no edition test on the default; the binder documents itself edition-agnostic
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: 2023 implies RECORD SEQUENTIAL, which is the same organization the compiler binds at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf21_01 covers OUTPUT/INPUT order and a WRITE without INVALID KEY; not EXTEND or REWRITE on a defaulted file, or the bare SEQUENTIAL spelling

probes.printed: F3 (no ORGANIZATION clause, RECORD VARYING) reads back in write order; F1 (bare SEQUENTIAL) EXTEND and REWRITE behave sequentially
files with no ORGANIZATION clause: OPEN/WRITE/CLOSE statuses 00, CLOSE of unopened 42, OPEN INPUT missing 35

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.6.3 GR3  (2.6.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: Absent clause leaves FileModel.Organization at its Sequential default; every probe file without the clause behaved as a sequential file.

refuter.evidence: Attacked whether a file control entry with no ORGANIZATION clause can drift into another organization from its other clauses. src/r4nokey.cob --std 85 (ACCESS MODE RANDOM, RECORD KEY, WRITE INVALID KEY, no ORGANIZATION): refused, COBOL1858 'ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM may not be specified for a sequential file ... record sequential by default, the ORGANIZATION clause being omitted', COBOL0863 RECORD KEY only for indexed, COBOL1720 INVALID KEY not for sequential. src/r4norel.cob (ACCESS DYNAMIC, RELATIVE KEY): COBOL1858 and COBOL0863 likewise. src/r4pad.cob (no ORGANIZATION, with the 1985 sequential-only clauses RESERVE 2 AREAS, PADDING CHARACTER, RECORD DELIMITER STANDARD-1, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL): compiled (COBOL1778 warning that RECORD DELIMITER has no effect), REWRITE in place 00, read back Q01, P02, END 10. The default is the sequential organization with sequential behaviour; the diagnostics cite §2023 clauses at --std 85, a wording matter. The ADVANCING read-back defect recorded under 1985-GR-VII.2.6.3-2 is a defect of retrieval, not of which organization is implied. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.6.3 GR3 the text is in GR3.
